description: This file defines the SQSAdapterFactory class, which implements the IQueueAdapterFactory interface for creating and managing SQS-based stream adapters in Orleans. It includes methods for initializing the factory, creating adapters, and handling delivery failure handlers, along with configuration options and dependency injection setup.

classes.name: SQSAdapterFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing SQS stream adapters, implementing the IQueueAdapterFactory interface, with configuration, initialization, and adapter creation logic.

methods.name: SQSAdapterFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with configuration options, serializer, logger, and stream queue mapper.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the factory, setting a default stream failure handler if none is provided.

methods.name: CreateAdapter
methods.description: Creates and returns a new SQSAdapter instance wrapped in a Task.

methods.name: GetQueueAdapterCache
methods.description: Returns the adapter cache used by the factory.

methods.name: GetStreamQueueMapper
methods.description: Returns the stream queue mapper used by the factory.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Returns a task that resolves to a stream failure handler for a given queue ID.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to create an instance of SQSAdapterFactory using dependency injection and configuration services.
